Condition : 1 - REFERENCE	L/676/5444
CASE OFFICER:	Graham Allison
LOCATION:			Railshead Bridge, Connecting St Margarets Road with Richmond Road
PROPOSAL:		Permanent diverting of existing services to new pipe bridges erected adjacent to the brick arch bridge. Replacing concrete slab under carriageway with new reinforced concrete slab. Repointing of all brickwork joints. Restoring the parapet walls and the iron straps on the copings
DRAWING NUMBER:  	LBH/H10/006A, 005A + 002
1.SITE DESCRIPTION

The bridge is located on the Just north of the junction with Railshead Road and enables the Richmond Road to Cross the River Crane. The bridge itself is has a footpath on either side of the main carriage way and brick walls form the barrier to the river. 

2. HISTORY

P1- Planning application of this consultation as the proposal spans two Boroughs.

3. DETAILS

The proposal is to provide an additional 14metre steel bridge supported by concrete footings on either side. The steel bridge is proposed on the eastern side of the bridge. And will carry the service pipes for water, telephones, and gas. To the western side of the bridge the new supports will be added to a new water pipe, which will be removed from the bridge.

The proposal also involves replacing the concrete slab under the carriageway and re-pointing all brick work jointings and restoring the parapet walls and iron straps on the copings.

4. CONSULTATIONS

Property	Street
415-421 (odds)	St Margarets Road
Franks House 	Richmond Road
Boat House	Richmond Road
Worple Primary School	Queens Terrace  

The Design and Conservation Officer stated that she had no objections to the proposal.

Highways stated that they had no objection to the proposal

English Heritage had no comments to make regarding the proposal

No comments were received from CIP.

5. POLICY

Adopted UDP 2003
